text:
sam: Quick Q — planning to change model selection behavior for /v1/generate. Proposal: introduce a client opt-in header `Accept-Model` that requests an exact model id. Default behavior remains backwards compatible for now. Need a compatibility checklist and deprecation timeline for the current default-mapping. Thoughts?

michelle: +1 to an explicit header. Two concerns: how fallback order works if the exact model isn't available, and how we surface deprecation to users. Suggest documented order: exact id -> pinned family variant -> degrade to next-best model with `X-Model-Warning`. Also recommend a 60–90 day deprecation window for default mappings.

aj: SDKs need a small ergonomic change: add `acceptModel` option to client constructors and helpers to set the header. Also suggest a client-side circuit-breaker when pinned model returns repeated 503s.

luke: nit: avoid `X-Model` (historical X- prefix baggage). `Accept-Model` mirrors `Accept-Language` and implies negotiation. prefer `Accept-Model: model-name@v1` format.

sam: good call on naming — let's go with `Accept-Model`. Rough rollout plan I'm thinking:
- stage 0: add header parsing in gateway + no-op docs mentions (no behavior change)
- stage 1: opt-in exact pinning (clients set header) + SDK helpers
- stage 2: emit deprecation warnings when default mapping used + dashboard metrics
- stage 3: flip deprecation after window and require header for exact selection.
Timeline suggestion: gateway parsing + docs in 2 weeks, SDK updates in 4 weeks, deprecation window 60 days after announcement.

cass: can we emit an informational response header when requests relied on default mapping? e.g. `X-Redwood-Model: default-mapping; X-Redwood-Deprecation-Warning: will-be-removed-in-60d`. Also add a banner in Console for orgs that are hitting defaults.

infra-sheriff-bot: FYI: gateway canary branch ready. Canary deploy scheduled Thu 09:00 UTC. Rollback trigger: >1% 5xx over 5m or increased tail latency 2x.

michelle: telemetry requests: counter for requests missing `Accept-Model`, histogram of models used when default mapping applies, and error-rate by model id. This will let us prioritize outreach.

sam: action items: @luke - add gateway PR with header parsing + tests; @aj - open SDK tickets for Node/Python + add example snippet; @cass - console warning banner + docs stub; @michelle - create telemetry dashboard and alert; I'll draft deprecation comms and recommended client migration steps.

aj: example curl I'll include in SDK tickets:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept-Model: redwood/fast-3b@2026-03" \
  -d '{"input":"summarize..."}'
```

deploy-bot: sam pinned canary build `gateway-feat/accept-model` -> canary (build 2026.03.15-ghi).

aj: I'll tag SDK owners and start draft PRs today.

sam: thanks everyone. I'll post the draft customer comms here once ready and link the migration guide. :thumbsup:
